categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of molecular sieve adsorbents and catalysts used in industrial gas separation, medical oxygen, energy chemical, petrochemical, renewable resources, and renewable energy sectors. Key business segments include gas separation, adsorption drying, life health, and raw powder materials. The company also provides technical services and solutions related to these materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced molecular sieve synthesis and shaping technologies, including lithium molecular sieves, deep cryogenic air separation molecular sieves, and PSA/VPSA technologies. It has proprietary technologies for producing molecular sieve adsorbents and catalysts with controlled crystal size, exchange degree, and silicon-aluminum ratio. Production involves synthesis of molecular sieve raw powder, activation, shaping, drying, and high-temperature calcination. The company emphasizes continuous innovation and process optimization to improve product performance and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large industrial gas companies, petrochemical enterprises, energy chemical firms, and medical oxygen providers. The company serves domestic markets extensively and has a growing overseas presence, especially in Southeast Asia, North America, Europe, and the Middle East. Major end markets include industrial gas separation, petrochemical refining, energy storage, sustainable aviation fuel production, and environmental protection sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Luoyang, Henan Province. It has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Thailand, Shanghai, and other locations. The Thai subsidiary serves as a global supply chain hub, supporting markets in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, Middle East, and Central Asia. Overseas sales accounted for over 25% of total revenue in 2024, reflecting significant international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing molecular sieve raw materials and shaped adsorbents and catalysts. It controls the full production chain from raw powder synthesis to finished molecular sieve products and technical services. This vertical integration provides quality control and cost advantages over competitors relying on external raw material suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation-driven growth with strategic emphasis on three core strategies: product quality, internationalization, and adsorption-catalysis integration. R&D priorities include developing molecular sieves for petrochemical aromatics separation, energy chemical applications, renewable energy (including sustainable aviation fuel catalysts), and new energy storage technologies. The company invests heavily in proprietary technology platforms and collaborates with research institutes to accelerate commercialization of advanced molecular sieve products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of molecular sieve materials, catalysts, and related technical services. The company mainly uses a direct sales model domestically, supplemented by distributors and customized product services. Overseas sales are conducted through subsidiaries and long-term partnerships with international industrial gas companies. Revenue recognition follows product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the molecular sieve industry, ranked first in China and third globally by production capacity. It competes with international giants like Honeywell, Arkema, and Zeochem, which dominate the mid-to-high-end market segments. The company has successfully achieved import substitution in several applications and maintains competitive advantages through full industry chain integration, scale, and continuous innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 778.7 million, a 19.9% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 74.8 million, down 51.15%. Despite short-term pressure from industry demand fluctuations, the company has a total asset base of about RMB 2.95 billion and equity of RMB 1.8 billion. Overseas sales grew by 13.36%, accounting for 25.55% of total revenue, indicating ongoing international expansion. The company invests around 4.5% of revenue in R&D to sustain growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance molecular sieve materials with superior adsorption capacity, selectivity, and energy efficiency, enabling import substitution and supporting customers' cost reduction and environmental goals. Its full industry chain control ensures product quality stability and cost competitiveness. The company differentiates through proprietary technologies in petrochemical aromatics separation, renewable energy catalysts, and advanced energy storage materials, positioning itself as a comprehensive technology service provider rather than just a materials manufacturer.
